import sys
from collections import defaultdict

# Define constants
MOD = 1000000007
INV = 570000004

def add_mod(a, b):
    sum_ = a + b
    return sum_ - MOD if sum_ >= MOD else sum_

def sub_mod(a, b):
    diff = a - b
    return diff + MOD if diff < 0 else diff

def mul_mod(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

# Read input
input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n = int(input[0])
p_values = input[1:]
p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
idx = 0
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] = int(p_values[idx])
        p[i][j] = mul_mod(p[i][j], INV)
        idx += 1

# Initialize data structures
index_map = {}
node_counter = 0
child_nodes = {}

def dfs(state):
    global node_counter
    state_tuple = tuple(state)
    if state_tuple in index_map:
        return index_map[state_tuple]
    id_ = node_counter
    index_map[state_tuple] = id_
    node_counter += 1
    child_nodes[id_] = [0] * (1 << node_counter)
    for mask in range(1 << node_counter):
        new_state = list(state)
        for j in range(1 << node_counter):
            if not new_state[j]:
                k_mask = mask & j
                k_mask_copy = k_mask
                while k_mask_copy:
                    k_bit = k_mask_copy & -k_mask_copy
                    k_mask_copy ^= k_bit
                    if state[j ^ (k_bit & -k_bit)]:
                        new_state[j] = 1
                        break
        child_nodes[id_][mask] = dfs(new_state)
    return id_

# Initialize the first state
initial_state = [0] * (1 << n)
initial_state[0] = 1
dfs(initial_state)

# Precompute q
q = [[1] * (1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(1 << n):
        val = 1
        for k in range(n):
            bit = (j >> k) & 1
            if bit:
                val = mul_mod(val, p[k][i])
            else:
                val = mul_mod(val, sub_mod(1, p[k][i]))
        q[i][j] = val

# Initialize DP array
dp = [[0] * (1 << node_counter) for _ in range(n + 1)]
dp[0][0] = 1

# Dynamic programming
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(node_counter):
        for k in range(1 << n):
            next_state = child_nodes[j][k]
            dp[i + 1][next_state] = add_mod(dp[i + 1][next_state], mul_mod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]))

# Compute result
result_state = [0] * (1 << n)
for i in range(1 << n):
    result_state[i] = 1
result_state_tuple = tuple(result_state)
result_index = index_map[result_state_tuple]
print(dp[n][result_index])
